priority_rules.sig_high_volume: 1–2★ reviews per day above the median of the 11 apps
priority_rules.sig_high_share: share of 1–2★ reviews (feed-gap days excluded) above the all-app share
priority_rules.sig_rising: last 4 weeks at least 10% above the first 4 weeks (STL patterns, Stage 1)
priority_rules.sig_forecast_up: week-1 forecast at least 5% above the last 4 weeks (Stage 3)
priority_rules.sig_unusual_days: at least 5 days above the 95% forecast interval (Stage 4)
priority_rules.sig_worse_release: at least one release made things worse (update impact, #138)

Swiggy.signs: many 1–2★ reviews a day; high share of 1–2★ reviews; forecast above recent level; a release made things worse

Flipkart.signs: many 1–2★ reviews a day; repeated days above the forecast interval; a release made things worse

Amazon.signs: high share of 1–2★ reviews; rising trend; repeated days above the forecast interval

Paytm.signs: rising trend; repeated days above the forecast interval; a release made things worse

Blinkit.signs: many 1–2★ reviews a day; rising trend

Meesho.signs: many 1–2★ reviews a day; repeated days above the forecast interval

Domino's.signs: high share of 1–2★ reviews; forecast above recent level

Myntra.signs: rising trend; repeated days above the forecast interval

charts.title: Which apps need attention first: six warning signs from all stages
charts.subtitle: Filled dot = the sign applies. Score = number of signs (3+ High, 2 Medium, 0–1 Low). Signs: 1–2★ reviews per day above the median app; share of 1–2★ reviews above all apps; last 4 weeks 10%+ above the first 4; reliable week-1 forecast 5%+ above the last 4 weeks; 5+ days above the 95% forecast interval; a release that made things worse.
